items.title: Rain Starts, TV Says No Signal: Why? The DTH Secret
items.description:
Why does your DTH show No Signal the moment it rains? Raindrops soak up the satellite signal. And here is why the dish is so small.

items.title: A National Park That Floats, Right Here in India!
items.description:
Keibul Lamjao on Manipur's Loktak Lake is the world's only floating national park, built on floating phumdis and home to the Sangai, the dancing deer.
Sources: Incredible India (Keibul Lamjao) https://www.incredibleindia.gov.in/en/manipur/imphal/keibul-lamjao-national-park

items.title: No Fridge, No Power: Why Is Matka Water Cool?
items.description:
How does a clay matka cool water with no electricity? The pot's own sweat is its AC. And here is why it works less in the monsoon.
Sources: MIT D-Lab clay pot coolers report https://d-lab.mit.edu/sites/default/files/inline-files/MIT%20D-Lab%20Clay%20Pot%20Cooles%20Report%202016-2021%2020211014_0.pdf
Springer study https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s43939-025-00516-z

#shorts #facts #matka #summer #english

items.title: Why Does Your ₹500 Note Have Lines on Its Edge?
items.description:

items.title: Did Oil Make Dubai Rich? Not Really!
items.description:
Oil is only about one to two percent of Dubai's economy today. Its port, airport and trade built the city, and Indians are the UAE's largest foreign community.
Sources: Zawya (Dubai govt statement on oil share) https://www.zawya.com/en/business/oil-revenues-make-up-less-than-1of-dubais-gdp-now-bssmoxjn
